labels.description: The heading replaces "increasing interest rates" with "a higher interest rate environment"; the body is unchanged apart from a removed page-number artifact.
labels.rationale: minor: stylistic rewording of the same interest rate exposure with no change to the risk, its severity, or any figure, plus a formatting artifact.

labels.description: Adds a new sentence that recent spending by hyperscalers and others to support AI is beginning to pressure supply chains for semiconductors and other network components, and extends the offset discussion to "cost and supply pressures" and lower-priced offerings "from us or our competitors".
labels.rationale: criterion 1 and 2: a new supply-chain exposure and a new specific development (AI-driven hyperscaler demand for semiconductors) is disclosed.

labels.description: Deletes the statement that credit rating agencies have been applying tighter credit standards when evaluating debt levels and future growth prospects, leaving only the generic downgrade risk.
labels.rationale: criterion 1 and 3: a previously disclosed adverse development (tighter rating agency standards) is removed, softening the borrowing-cost risk.

labels.description: Only a page-number artifact ("8") is removed; the risk factor text is otherwise identical.
labels.rationale: minor: a formatting artifact equivalent to punctuation, with no change in substance.

labels.description: Drops the disclosure of the voluntary C-Band precautionary measures near certain airports through January 1, 2028 following FAA radio altimeter concerns, and adds state rate regulation of broadband to the issues driving proposed or new legislation.
labels.rationale: criterion 2: a specific regulatory matter (the FAA C-Band commitment) is dropped and a new regulatory area (state broadband rate regulation) is referenced.

labels.description: Replaces "climate change's impacts" with "its impacts" in the final sentence.
labels.rationale: minor: stylistic rewording with identical meaning.

labels.description: Deletes the disclosure that the FCC's spectrum auction authority lapsed in 2023 and that the 2023 national spectrum strategy left future spectrum availability uncertain, replaces the COVID-19 pandemic with "recent world events and trends" as the usage driver, and adds the fixed wireless access product and "standalone or converged" 5G and fiber offerings.
labels.rationale: criterion 2: a specific regulatory development (the lapsed FCC auction authority and national spectrum strategy) and a named event (COVID-19) are dropped, and a new product (fixed wireless access) is referenced.

labels.description: Only a page-number artifact ("9") is inserted; the risk factor text is otherwise identical.
labels.rationale: minor: a formatting artifact equivalent to punctuation, with no change in substance.

labels.description: Widens the reputational and litigation risk to cover the safety of services, products and operations, proceedings arising in or outside the ordinary course of business, and alleged misconduct by contractors or other third parties in addition to employees.
labels.rationale: criterion 1 and 3: a new exposure (safety) is added and the scope of covered proceedings and actors is widened.

labels.description: Adds customer use of mobile devices for AI-enabled applications as a new driver of demand for higher-quality services.
labels.rationale: criterion 1 and 2: a new demand driver and development (AI-enabled applications) is disclosed as part of the risk.
